verdict.rationale: The product documents its own install paths: Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add` and `/plugin install` slash commands, plus a project-local option of copying the skill folders into `.claude/skills/`. A file copy is something an agent could do without prompts, but nothing frames any of these paths as a headless or agent-driven install, and the slash commands are in-session interactive commands. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented non-interactive/headless install command (e.g. a shell one-liner or CLI flag), confirmation that an agent can complete the install end to end without user prompts, and hands-on corroboration.
